description: Add and update Mautic contacts from sign-ups and forms, tag and score them, put them in segments and campaigns, send them emails and unsubscribe them. Start a workflow for a new contact, a form submission or a contact added to a segment.

mautic_contact_added_to_segment_trigger.description: Runs when a contact joins a segment: added by hand, by a campaign or workflow, or matched by the segment's filters when Mautic updates it.

parameters.description: The segment to watch. Pick one, or type its name or ID.
parameters.name: segment

mautic_new_contact_trigger.description: Runs when Mautic gets a new contact it knows by email or name, from a form, an import or another app. Anonymous visitors don't run it.

mautic_new_form_submission_trigger.description: Runs when someone fills in a Mautic form, with the values they gave and the contact it made or updated.

parameters.description: The form to watch. Pick one, or type its name or ID.
